text:
tessa (SRE): Quick thought: run a 10-business-day 'closure window' after PM publishes. Every action must have an owner, due_date, and tiny lifecycle: triage -> work -> verify. Weekly 25m sync until closed.

ben: sounds good. keep the tracker tiny so it actually gets used. what fields?

tessa (SRE): minimal: id, owner, svc, bucket, priority (P0/P1/P2), due_date, status, verify_link, rc_category (infra/config/deploy/third_party), recurrence_flag. owner+due_date required.

olga: +1. add a one-line "impact_if_unfixed" field to help prioritize. also a bool "regression_risk".

ben: rotation idea: current monthly IC swap loses context. propose 6-week IC slots with a 1-week overlap handoff where both ICs shadow follow-ups.

tessa (SRE): overlap week is nice. reduces action drop-off when IC changes.

ops-bot: automated: "Reminder: 2 open PM actions assigned to ben >4 days. Run /pm-list to view."

olga: automation wishlist: bot DMs owners at 48h and 7d, and marks action stale after 14d. if stale, auto-assign a reviewer from the rotation pool.

tessa (SRE): agree. verification must be light: 1-2 sentence note + link to dashboard or smoke-test commands. optionally a 3-step checklist for deploy->smoke->monitor.

ben: can we detect recurring patterns? if svc+bucket appears >1 in 30d, flag it and add to the weekly agenda. if flagged twice in 60d, escalate to a recurrence workshop.

tessa (SRE): yes. we'll add tagging so rollups are trivial. I'll draft a one-pager with a tracker CSV template, weekly invite body, and IC overlap recommendation and post in #eng-oncall tomorrow.

olga: i'll run the pilot for the next two P1 incidents (IDs: 6122, 6130). i'll host the first sync and capture metrics (median time-to-verify, stale_count, recurrence_flags).

ops-bot: automated: "Label follow-through-pilot applied to incidents 6122, 6130."

tessa (SRE): thanks. if pilot works: next steps = small repo with template + ops-bot scripts + update to IC rotation docs. low friction please.

ben: one tiny ask: bot reminders should DM owners only, not spam channels.

tessa (SRE): yes. bot will DM owners + post a small summary thread update. thanks all.
